instructions: Evaluate only the captured case prompt, deterministic reference summary, normalized tool trajectory, and final response artifacts supplied for the pair.
Judge the candidates independently of their left or right position. Reverse presentation order is a required bias check.
Do not prefer a candidate merely because it is longer, more polished, more conversational, or uses richer formatting.
Prefer task-relevant correctness, continuity, grounded use of available evidence, and clear communication.
Return Tie when differences are only verbosity or style and do not change task-relevant meaning or usability.
Return Abstain when the supplied artifacts are insufficient for a defensible qualitative comparison.
A judge preference is advisory. It cannot override a deterministic reference or resolve an order-inconsistent pair.

outputSchema.reason: Short evidence-grounded explanation without hidden chain-of-thought.
